buildkit_url.description: URL for a running buildkit daemon.

password.description: The password for authenticating to the registry as `username`.

registry_url.description: The base url of the registry you want to support communicating with.

username.description: The username you want to use to authenticate to the registry.

args.description: Arguments that should be made available to the image being built by Buildkit. Used to set values for ARG commands in the Dockerfile.

context.description: Path to the directory that should be used as the docker context.

dockerfile.description: Path to the Dockerfile. For now this is expected to live somewhere within the context dir already.

forward_ssh_agent_socket.description: Should the host running Terraform make their ssh agent socket available to the image being built by Buildkit?

id.description: A unique identifier for the image.

image_digest.description: The sha256 digest of the docker image. This is the canonical content addressable hash for a docker image.

labels.description: Labels that should be added to the metadata f the image being built by Buildkit. Equivalent to LABEL commands in the Dockerfile.

platforms.description: Target platforms / architectures that should be supported by the image being built by Buildkit.

secrets.description: A map of secrets in key => value form that will be made accessible to the image being built by Buildkit.

secrets_base64.description: A map of secrets in key => base64_encoded_value form that will be made accessible to the image being built by Buildkit.

triggers.description: A map of strings that will cause a change to the counter when any of the values change.

digest_url.description: The tag you want to publish this particular build as.

name.description: The name of the repository within the registry you want to publish to.

registry_url.description: The base url of the registry you want to publish to.

tag.description: The tag you want to publish this particular build as.

tag_url.description: The tag you want to publish this particular build as.

block.description: Describes a coordinate where you want to publish the image after building.
A docker image built with buildkit and published to target registries.

context.description: Path to the directory that should be used as the docker context.

hash.description: The hash of the directory, excluding any .dockerignore files.

images.description: The image results of your query.

labels.description: Required label keys / values to filter the returned images by.

most_recent_only.description: Should all images be returned that match the criteria or only the most recent which matches?

registry_url.description: The registry url you want to search.

repository_name.description: The repository name you want to search.

supported_platforms.description: Required platforms that must be supported by the returned images.

tag_pattern.description: A regex pattern you want to filter tags by.
